messages:
maya: Dropped a fresh draft of the product launch blog into Drive. Includes benchmark highlights, short methodology note, and 2 CTA paths (webinar vs demo). Link: https://drive.redwood/launch-draft-v3
jonathan: Reviewing now. Do we want the opening to lead with the cost win or enterprise reliability? both read strong but different audiences.
lina: I'd lead with cost for PLG folks, reliability for mid-market. We should have two hero options and swap by audience (A/B).
harry: Agree on A/B hero. Also: for the webinar CTA, propose 'Watch a 20-min demo + cost breakdown'. That's concise.
maya: Good call on two hero variants. Drafted short copy for both. For benchmarks I used median p50 latency and per-token unit cost; flagged sample size in appendix.
e ellen: Quick legal check on the benchmark claim: you have "~3x lower unit cost" in the hero. Need the exact phrasing and caveat. Can you change to: "up to 3x lower unit cost in our internal tests" and add "See appendix for test rig and configs."
maya: Updated to "up to 3x" and added the appendix link. Also added the one-line disclosure Ellen suggested.
publish-bot: preview created: https://staging.redwood/preview/launch-v3  snapshot saved
kevin: Heads up: growth wants two social hooks — data-led (stat) and customer-led (reliability story). I'll draft both.
skyler: On routing: Sales requests demo-intent leads (CTA: 'Request demo') go to AE queue 'LaunchEnterprise' and webinar RSVPs go to marketing_list:webinar-launch. Can HubSpot do both for people who click both CTAs?
harry: Yes. We'll dual-route based on form field. Plan: form -> add to webinar list + if 'interest' == 'demo' then add AE tag. I'll update the workflow and set AE webhook.
johnathan: small nit: the hero image with a stacked latency vs cost chart might be busy on mobile. Lina can you produce a simplified mobile-first hero?
lina: Yep, will make a mobile-optimized hero with a single metric highlight and small caption.
maya: Timing: thinking a canary push Thu 9:30am PST to a small segment (docs and newsletter) then full publish Thu 11am PST. Any blockers?
kevin: Can we schedule social for 11:10am PST? gives search index a minute. Also include UTM params: ?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=launch_v3
maya: Done. Assigning final publish task to me. @ellen last check on compliance language?
e ellen: Looks good after the "up to" edit. small trademark note: add ® after Redwood in first paragraph.
maya: Added ®. Final checklist: hero A/B ready, benchmarks disclaimer added, HubSpot routing updated, hero mobile asset incoming, social snippets drafted. If no objections I'll run the canary Thu 9:30am PST.
kevin: Approved from growth.
skyler: Routing confirmed from sales.
harry: Ops approved.
maya: Kicking off canary and will post results here. Thanks everyone!"
